result_excerpt:
The service already matched most of the technical design. I added the missing welcome endpoint.

### What was already in place
- Spring Boot + Maven (`pom.xml` with `spring-boot-starter-web` and `spring-boot-starter-actuator`)
- `GET /health` returning `OK`
- Dockerfile at repo root
- Tests for health and application context

### What I added
- **`HelloController`** — `GET /hello` returns `OK` (same contract as `/health`, per the design constraint)
- **`HelloControllerTest`** — verifies `/hello` returns HTTP 200 with body `OK`

### Verification
- `./mvnw test` — all tests pass
- `docker build` — succeeds

The service exposes:
| Endpoint | Response |
|----------|----------|
| `GET /health` | `OK` |
| `GET /hello` | `OK` |
| `GET /actuator/health` | Spring Actuator health (configured in `application.properties`) |
